title: State Commission Jurisdiction for Complaints Exceeding Rs. 1 Crore

content.scenario: A consumer in Delhi files a complaint against a company for a defective product worth Rs. 5 crores. The complaint is filed with the State Commission.
content.outcome: The State Commission has jurisdiction to entertain the complaint, as the value of the goods or services paid as consideration exceeds Rs. 1 crore but does not exceed Rs. 10 crore, as per Section 47(1) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What is the jurisdiction of the State Commission for complaints exceeding Rs. 1 crore?
Can a complaint worth Rs. 5 crores be filed with the State Commission?
What are the conditions for the State Commission to entertain a complaint?
